definition: κολλύριον, see: κολλούριον. κολλούριον (TTr., κολλύ-, the more usual form), -ου, τό (dimin. of κολλύρα = κόλλιξ, a coarse bread roll), [in LXX: 3Ki.12:24 hil B* ;] __1. a small bread roll (LXX, ll. with).  __2. (Usually in pl., LS, see word) an eye salve shaped like a roll: Rev.3:18.† (AS)
